metadata.analyzed_by: AWS Transform Custom — Agentic Readiness Analysis
metadata.archetype_justification: Application uses MySQL database for persistent state, exposes CRUD operations on orders (index, create, show), and handles user-specific data including payment card numbers.

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes Rails controller actions (index, create, show) but has no documented API interface. No REST documentation, no OpenAPI spec, no route definitions. Controller renders HTML views only. Integration would require UI automation or direct database access.
findings.gap: No documented, stable API interface exists. Agents cannot bind to an undocumented HTML-rendering controller.
findings.recommendation: Create a RESTful JSON API layer and publish an OpenAPI 3.x specification.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Create a RESTful JSON API layer and publish an OpenAPI specification.
blocker_remediation.target_state: A versioned REST API with JSON responses and an OpenAPI 3.x specification file.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: The application has no authentication mechanism. The controller notes 'No before_filter auth on some actions (legacy oversight).' No OAuth2, no API key authentication, no mTLS, no service accounts. All requests are anonymous.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication exists. All requests are anonymous and unattributable.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication with principal attribution.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key or OAuth2 client credentials authentication on all endpoints.
blocker_remediation.target_state: OAuth2 client credentials flow with principal attribution in audit logs.

findings.title: Credentials Committed to Source Control
findings.description: Payment gateway credentials (merchant_id, api_password) are committed to source control in plaintext in config/payment.yml. The controller loads these directly from the checked-in file. No secrets management system exists.
findings.gap: Credentials are hardcoded in version-controlled files. No secrets management or rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Remove config/payment.yml from version control, rotate credentials immediately, store in AWS Secrets Manager.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Remove config/payment.yml from version control, rotate exposed credentials, store in AWS Secrets Manager.
blocker_remediation.target_state: All secrets managed via AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: No authorization model exists. No IAM policies, no role definitions, no permission checks. All requests have full access to all operations.
findings.gap: No mechanism to scope agent access to specific operations or resources.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control or deploy API Gateway with IAM-based resource policies.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway with IAM-based resource policies
Restrict network access to known agent IPs/VPCs

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. The application cannot distinguish between read and write operations from an authorization perspective.
findings.gap: No fine-grained authorization differentiating read vs write operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization checks or API Gateway method-level authorization.

compensating_controls: Use API Gateway method-level authorization (GET vs POST)
Implement proxy filtering allowed HTTP methods per caller

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation exists. Since there is no authentication at all, there is no identity to propagate. Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.gap: No identity propagation mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based identity propagation as part of AUTH-Q1 remediation.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway to inject caller identity headers
Implement identity propagation with AUTH-Q1 remediation

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging configured. No CloudTrail, no structured logging, no immutable log storage. Default Rails file-based logging with no principal attribution.
findings.gap: No immutable audit trail. Cannot determine who or what made any request.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured logging with principal attribution, ship to immutable store.

ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents still require audit attribution but it is not a deployment blocker.
compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway logging all requests to CloudWatch Logs
Enable CloudTrail for the AWS account

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Capability
findings.description: No authentication mechanism exists, so there is no agent identity to suspend or revoke.
findings.gap: No identity lifecycle management — cannot isolate or suspend a specific agent.
findings.recommendation: Implement machine identity (AUTH-Q1) then add suspension capability.

compensating_controls: Use API Gateway API keys with deletion capability
Use network-level controls to block specific agents

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback for Multi-Step Operations
findings.description: The create action performs a two-step operation (save order, charge card) with no compensation. If charge_card fails after save, the order remains with no payment — a partial state.
findings.gap: Multi-step operations have no rollback. Failed payment leaves orphaned orders.
findings.recommendation: Wrap order creation and payment in a transaction with compensation logic.

ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Read-only agents do not execute write workflows, but compensation capability is still relevant for system maturity.
compensating_controls: Wrap in database transaction with rollback on charge failure
Implement pending state that transitions only after successful payment

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience Patterns
findings.description: Synchronous SOAP call to external payment gateway with no circuit breaker, no timeout, no retry logic, and no error handling.
findings.gap: No resilience patterns for external dependency calls. Payment gateway failure cascades.
findings.recommendation: Add timeout, circuit breaker, and retry logic to payment gateway integration.

compensating_controls: Set connection and read timeouts on HTTP client
Deploy circuit breaker at infrastructure level

findings.title: No Rate Limiting or Throttling
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application-level rate limiting middleware.
findings.gap: No rate limiting to prevent agent loops from overwhelming the application.
findings.recommendation: Deploy AWS API Gateway or WAF with throttling rules.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway or WAF with rate limiting rules
Configure Apache connection limits

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed in API Responses
findings.description: Application stores credit card numbers and payment credentials. SELECT * returns all fields including card data with no filtering or field-level access control.
findings.gap: Agent-facing API responses include sensitive fields (card numbers, expiration dates) with no filtering.
findings.recommendation: Implement response serializers that exclude sensitive fields. Adopt PCI DSS-compliant tokenization.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to RISK-SAFETY: agent_scope=read-only, B1 fires as RISK-SAFETY
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 fires because SELECT * returns card_number and card_exp fields in general API responses without exclusion.

b1.reasoning: SELECT * returns sensitive card data in general API responses with no field filtering. Under read-only scope, this resolves to RISK-SAFETY.

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation exists — a single anonymous access level grants access to everything.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists (no tags, no annotations, no Macie integration).

compensating_controls: Implement read-only API view selecting only non-sensitive fields
Deploy API Gateway response transformation stripping sensitive fields

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for PCI Data
findings.description: PCI-regulated payment card data stored in MySQL on EC2 with no data residency controls, no region restrictions, no compliance boundary enforcement.
findings.gap: No data residency or sovereignty controls for PCI-regulated data.
findings.recommendation: Implement data residency controls. Tokenize card data so agents never access raw card numbers.

ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Data residency is relevant for read-only agents accessing PCI data but the risk profile is lower than write-enabled scope.
compensating_controls: Ensure LLM endpoint is in same AWS region as database
Implement data classification and residency policies at platform layer

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction. Default Rails logging logs request parameters including card numbers via params[:order]. No log scrubbing, no filter_parameter_logging configured.
findings.gap: PII (payment card numbers) leaks into Rails request parameter logs.
findings.recommendation: Add filter_parameter_logging for sensitive fields immediately.

compensating_controls: Add filter_parameter_logging :card_number, :card_exp, :password
Deploy log scrubbing at infrastructure level

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, or Smithy specification exists in the repository.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.x specification for the orders endpoints.

compensating_controls: Manually author OpenAPI spec from controller analysis
Use API recording tools to generate spec

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: Controller renders HTML views on failure. No JSON error structures, no error codes, no retryable indicators.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish error types or determine retry eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent JSON error format with error_code, message, and retryable fields.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway translating errors to structured JSON
Implement custom exception handler

findings.title: State Not Queryable in Structured Form
findings.description: Show and index actions exist but render HTML only. An agent cannot programmatically query current state.
findings.gap: State queryable only via HTML rendering, not structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add JSON response support to show and index actions.

compensating_controls: Add .json response format to existing actions
Deploy read-only API proxy with structured responses

findings.title: No Sandbox or Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Payment config hardcoded to mode: live. No environment-specific configurations.
findings.gap: Cannot test agent behavior without risk to live payment processing.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with sandbox payment gateway and synthetic data.

compensating_controls: Create Docker-based local testing with mock payment gateway
Use feature flag for sandbox payment endpoint

findings.title: No Pagination or Result Size Limits
findings.description: Index action returns all orders matching status with no pagination, no configurable sorting, no result size limits. Unbounded result sets possible.
findings.gap: No pagination, no result size limits.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination and maximum result size limits.

compensating_controls: Add LIMIT clause to SQL query
Implement pagination at proxy layer

findings.title: No Input Validation or Schema Enforcement
findings.description: No input validation at API boundary. params[:order] passed directly to Order.new. params[:status] interpolated into SQL. Mass-assignment and SQL injection vulnerabilities.
findings.gap: No input validation, no schema enforcement, no structured validation errors.
findings.recommendation: Add attr_accessible, parameterize SQL, implement validation with structured errors.

compensating_controls: Deploy WAF with request validation rules
Implement API Gateway request validators

findings.title: Limited Temporal Metadata
findings.description: created_at exists (referenced in ORDER BY) but no updated_at tracking, no timezone normalization, no freshness headers.
findings.gap: No update timestamps, no freshness signaling.
findings.recommendation: Ensure updated_at maintained with UTC normalization. Add freshness headers.

compensating_controls: Add updated_at column
Add Last-Modified headers

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API versioning, no contract testing, no breaking change detection.
findings.gap: No versioning strategy or contract stability mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning and contract testing in CI pipeline.

compensating_controls: Implement consumer-driven contract tests
Version API URL path

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing, no structured logging. Default Rails plain-text log files. No OpenTelemetry, X-Ray, trace IDs, or correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Agent-initiated requests cannot be traced through the system.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with OpenTelemetry/X-Ray. Implement structured JSON logging.

compensating_controls: Deploy API Gateway generating trace IDs
Implement structured logging middleware

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: No alerting on error rates or latency for agent-consumed APIs.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rate and latency thresholds.

compensating_controls: Deploy CloudWatch alarms on Apache access logs
Use synthetic monitoring

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC exists. Manually provisioned architecture deployed via Capistrano 2 to fixed EC2 hosts. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or Helm.
findings.gap: No IaC, no peer-reviewed infrastructure changes, no drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure as Terraform/CloudFormation. Enable AWS Config for drift detection.

compensating_controls: Document current infrastructure state
Implement AWS Config rules

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline or Contract Testing
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. No automated testing. No contract testing. README states tests are stale.
findings.gap: No automated API contract validation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with API contract testing.

compensating_controls: Set up basic CI pipeline as first step
Add contract tests once API formalized

findings.title: No Automated Rollback Capability
findings.description: Capistrano 2 manual rollback only. No automated rollback, no blue/green, no canary deployment.
findings.gap: No automated rollback capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated rollback via CodeDeploy or blue/green deployment.

compensating_controls: Document manual Capistrano rollback procedure
Implement feature flags

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests exist. README states tests are stale and no longer run. No test directory present.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage for agent-facing APIs.
findings.recommendation: Create automated API tests covering input handling, output format, and error responses.

compensating_controls: Write integration tests for order endpoints
Use Postman/Newman collections for smoke tests

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest configuration. MySQL 5.1 on EC2 predates RDS encryption. No KMS, no encrypted EBS. Card numbers stored unencrypted.
findings.gap: Data at rest (including card numbers) likely unencrypted.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with KMS encryption or configure EBS encryption.

compensating_controls: Enable EBS encryption on MySQL EC2 instance
Plan migration to RDS with encryption

items.summary: Resolve all 3 BLOCKERs and address critical RISK-SAFETY findings to unblock agent integration evaluation.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings to improve agent effectiveness and operational maturity.
Implement test coverage and remaining quality improvements for long-term agent reliability.

recommended_actions.action: Implement machine identity and secrets management
recommended_actions.rationale: Authentication is the foundational blocker — without identity, no other security control can function. Secrets remediation (AUTH-Q5) is independent and fast.

recommended_actions.action: Create RESTful JSON API with OpenAPI specification
recommended_actions.rationale: No documented API interface is the primary integration blocker. Requires runtime upgrade from EOL Ruby 1.8.7/Rails 2.3.
PCI-regulated card data is exposed without filtering. Tokenization and field-level controls are required before any agent access.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting and observability
recommended_actions.rationale: API Gateway provides rate limiting, audit logging, tracing, and alerting as a single deployment — addressing multiple findings simultaneously.
Engineering maturity is required for safe, repeatable deployments and agent-facing API contract stability.
